subjectMappings.subject: spend and calls
subjectMappings.mapping: Overview opens on a spend card top right of the summary row: 26-40px Martian Mono total, a 6px budget bar split into tier segments, the budget beneath; every money, count, id and duration is Martian Mono tabular

subjectMappings.subject: router on/off
subjectMappings.mapping: a switch with a mint track sits at the right end of the floating segmented navbar on all four pages; off turns the track grey and the label to Off

subjectMappings.subject: four ordered tiers
subjectMappings.mapping: each tier owns one hue shown only as a 8px square dot plus its name, and as its segment of the spend bar; badges, select options, list rows and table cells reuse the same dot

subjectMappings.subject: the call log
subjectMappings.mapping: Activity and every List read as ledger rows: hairline rules, a mono time column on the left, status as dot plus word, no cards around rows

ground.source: hue-traced near-black oklch(0.16 0.006 265) lit by a wide radial top light at 50% of oklch(0.3 0.03 200), over a 24px graph grid at 3% ink masked out below the first screen; light theme oklch(0.985 0.003 265) with a 5% grid
ground.textSeparation: text always sits on raised surfaces (dark oklch(0.205 0.007 265), light white); primary ink at least 13:1, muted ink oklch(0.68 0.01 265) at least 5:1 in dark and oklch(0.5 0.01 265) at least 5:1 in light
ground.reducedMotion: the grid is static in every mode; nothing on the ground moves

quietRegions.region: open space left of the spend figure on Overview
gap between the Overview summary band and the health list

palette.regionalAssignment: cool neutrals own ground, cards, rules and text; mint owns only the router switch track, focus ring and the logo tile; tier hues own only their dot and budget segment; primary buttons are ink on ground; light theme recuts hues at L 0.5-0.6

traits.construction: wide-skeleton contemporary grotesk for UI over a wide geometric monospace for figures
traits.width: normal UI at 13-14px, display 650 weight with -0.02em tracking
traits.utility: Martian Mono for money, counts, ids, models and durations
traits.display: Mona Sans 650 at 22-28px for page titles; Martian Mono 500 at 26-40px for the spend total

display.sourceEvidence: user steer on sketch 001: "all look bad, no good looking fonts, bad looking components"; sketch 002 offered this pairing as the recommended Console and the tab exited 3, so the recommendation stands

body.sourceEvidence: user steer on sketch 001: "all look bad, no good looking fonts, bad looking components"; sketch 002 offered this pairing as the recommended Console and the tab exited 3, so the recommendation stands

contract.materialLight: one soft light from above: navbar, cards, popups and toasts are raised surfaces with a 1px hairline, a 1px inset top highlight at white 5% and a short dark shadow; the active nav segment is a lighter pill; three elevation steps

motion.decision: motion shows cause only: toasts rise 12px in 200ms ease-out-quint, popups scale from 0.97 and fade in 180ms, tab and nav indicators slide 220ms, the lamp crossfades 300ms, spend counts up 600ms once
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion removes every slide, scale and count; changes become instant opacity swaps under 80ms

expectations: the ground shows a soft top light over a faint grid that fades below the first screen
the navbar is one floating segmented bar with an active pill and a mint switch at its right end
every money, count, id and duration renders in Martian Mono with tabular figures
tier appears only as a small hue dot or budget segment beside its name, never as a filled card
popups open centered with a raised shadow; nothing slides in from a side
light and dark themes both keep muted text at least 4.5:1
contract.title: Console
contract.description: A dark console with a soft top light over a faint grid: Mona Sans for UI, Martian Mono figures, a segmented navbar with a mint router switch, raised cards with hairlines and inset highlights, and one small hue per tier.
